priority_order_followed: continuous PAMAP2 transition task redesigned from raw streams
another lawful session disjoint temporal dataset

attempts.rights: PAMAP2 Physical Activity Monitoring, public research dataset
attempts.design: given a raw IMU window, name the activity two seconds after the window ends. Windows that straddle a transition are kept rather than dropped.
differs_from_the_invalid_bed: label lies in the future so sequence state is required
attempts.note: refuted on event count before it was refuted on the gate: the scripted protocol separates every activity with a rest label, so the whole dataset contains 22 direct activity to activity transitions across 9 subjects. At that prevalence the future label is almost always the current activity and the task collapses back into the window classification bed that was already invalid.

attempts.rights: HARTH Human Activity Recognition Trondheim, public research dataset, downloaded for this program
attempts.design: given a three second window of back and thigh accelerometry, name the activity two seconds after the window ends. Transition and non transition windows are sampled at equal rate.
differs_from_the_invalid_bed: free living rather than scripted, so activity changes are frequent and unannounced
attempts.note: one bounded repair was applied: at natural prevalence only 5 percent of windows straddle a change, so the first gate correctly rejected the bed. Balancing transition and non transition windows changes the sampling only, not the labels, the signal or the units. Both gate results are reported.

attempts.domain: Speaker disjoint continuous audio, streaming keyword identity
attempts.rights: Speech Commands v0.02, public (CC BY 4.0), Google
attempts.design: three keyword clips from one speaker are concatenated into a stream and the label is the keyword that ends the stream.
differs_from_the_invalid_bed: a different modality from the two accelerometry attempts
the label depends on position in the stream, not on which keywords are present
144 training speakers and 63 test speakers, speaker disjoint
returning contexts, because keywords recur across streams
attempts.note: attempted because both accelerometry style attempts failed the order gate in the same way: the set of values in a window carried the answer and their order did not. This attempt is designed so that an order free reader sees an identical frame set whichever keyword came last.

valid_third_domains: Speaker disjoint continuous audio, streaming keyword identity
status: secondary. A third domain can support or fail to support the premise, it cannot carry a principal verdict on its own, and the principal matrix stays HAR and Speech Commands.
not_repeated: PAMAP2 window classification, which was already invalid
